$comment: PREDICATE FIELD-SURFACE POISON FIXTURE (#306) — the shared, two-language pin on WHICH model
registry fields the `@mentions_registry_model` predicate may read.
WHY IT EXISTS. The literal fences bound what the two interpreters may COMPARE an error text
against. They say nothing about which registry FIELDS a predicate reads, and a widening needs
no string literal at all: adding `m.Provider` (Go) / `m.provider` (TS) to the predicate makes
every clause gated on it fire for any text that merely names a vendor — `Anthropic API: this
model is not available on your current plan` becomes model_unavailable — while every literal
allowlist stays satisfied, the generated table and the stress golden stay byte-identical, and
no corpus row can see it, because no corpus row contains a bare provider name.
HOW IT PINS. `models` below is a synthetic registry of exactly one entry. Every field the
predicate is ALLOWED to read (`reads`) carries a normal-looking value; every other string in
the entry — at any depth, including array elements — carries a unique sentinel. The two
suites then assert, from this one file:
NEGATIVE  no sentinel makes the predicate fire. Reading one more field turns that field's
sentinel into a hit, and the assertion is red on both sides at once.
POSITIVE  every field named in `reads` DOES make it fire. Dropping a read is red too, so
the pin is an exact set rather than an upper bound.
SCHEMA    every key path present in the real registry appears here. A new registry field
is unpinned until this fixture declares it, and that is red rather than silent.
Go   internal/terminalkind/predicates_test.go points `mentionsAnyModel` at these models.
SDK  packages/nightgauge-sdk/tests/analysis/health/terminalKind.predicateFields.test.ts
mocks the registry module with them and drives the real classifier.
The entry must stay decodable as internal/models.ModelDescriptor with unknown fields
REJECTED, which is what keeps `SCHEMA` honest in the other direction: a key that is not in
the Go struct fails the fixture load rather than sitting here pinning nothing.
